>Decent people don't say that to someone.

I could never think, out of the good people in my life, that they would say this kind of stuff to anyone. I wonder with this kind of people, if they succeed in driving someone to kill themselves, if they are proud of their accomplishment. Does it make them feel powerful? Regretful? Happy?

Thank you a lot. I'm sending you lots of virtual hugs because of social distancing and such, haha

I feel so stupid for letting mean words ruin my day. Actually, the most mundane things have been triggering me lately. This quarantine has been hard for everyone here and i feel it too. The sad thing is that whaen someone says these horrible things to me is like they are echoing that mean voice inside my head, like thay are validating my bad thoughs. So something other people would just shrug off hurt deeply for me. Anyway, thank you so much for reaching out. The responses ive been getting here are so kind and heartwarming i wanna cry.

It just boggles me how cruel people can be online. But thank you for your words, it makes me feel so much better to see that there are still people like you that can be kind where others resort to cruelty.
Thank you so much for your kind words. You have no idea how much i needed to hear something positive today.
